description: SEBI-registered entity holding securities in dematerialized format on behalf of investors.

FILED.status_explanation: Your complaint regarding Demat account, share transfer, or pledge/unpledge has been filed with the Depository Participant.
FILED.recommended_action: Obtain and save the DP ticket/service request number from your DP portal or acknowledgement email.
suggested_documents: Copy of complaint submitted to DP (may be useful for your grievance record)
Client Master Report (CMR) or Demat Transaction Statement if relevant
FILED.official_portal: DP investor portal / designated grievance email
FILED.conditions: Initial stage. Intermediary acknowledgement is awaited.
FILED.guidance_notes: Depository Participants must provide an acknowledgement with a trackable service request ID.
FILED.disclaimer: Official regulatory process information. Any simulated time windows are demo configurations for testing.

ACKNOWLEDGED.status_explanation: The Depository Participant has acknowledged receipt of your complaint and initiated internal verification.
ACKNOWLEDGED.recommended_action: Store the acknowledgement receipt or ticket confirmation for future reference.
suggested_documents: DP complaint acknowledgement receipt (may be useful for your grievance record)
Copy of original complaint (may be useful for your grievance record)
ACKNOWLEDGED.guidance_notes: DP operations verify transaction records with the respective Depository (CDSL or NSDL).
ACKNOWLEDGED.disclaimer: Official regulatory process information. Any simulated time windows are demo configurations for testing.

AWAITING_RESPONSE.status_explanation: Your complaint is currently awaiting a formal response or resolution from the Depository Participant.
AWAITING_RESPONSE.recommended_action: Monitor your registered email for DP communications. Keep your Demat holding statement ready.
suggested_documents: DP complaint acknowledgement receipt (may be useful for your grievance record)
Demat holding/transaction statement (DIS slip, pledge request, etc.)
Copy of original complaint (may be useful for your grievance record)
AWAITING_RESPONSE.escalation_path: Depository Grievance Cell (CDSL / NSDL) or SEBI SCORES 2.0
AWAITING_RESPONSE.conditions: If no response is received within the configured timeframe (e.g. 30-day demo configuration), escalation may be initiated.
AWAITING_RESPONSE.guidance_notes: If the DP does not resolve the issue, the investor may approach the central depository (NSDL/CDSL) or SEBI SCORES.
AWAITING_RESPONSE.disclaimer: Internal warning timestamps and time windows are demo configurations for simulation purposes, not statutory regulatory deadlines.

RESPONSE_RECEIVED.status_explanation: The Depository Participant has issued a response or resolution letter.
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.recommended_action: Examine if the Demat balance, share transfer, or fee reversal matches your expectation. If unresolved, prepare for escalation.
suggested_documents: DP formal response letter/email (may be useful for your grievance record)
DP acknowledgement receipt (may be useful for your grievance record)
Updated Demat statement (may be useful for your grievance record)
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.escalation_path: Depository Investor Grievance Cell (CDSL/NSDL) or SEBI SCORES 2.0
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.conditions: If DP response does not resolve the issue or rejects the claim.
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.guidance_notes: Check whether the depository ledger has been updated accurately before confirming resolution.
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.disclaimer: Official regulatory process information. Any simulated time windows are demo configurations for testing.

RESOLVED.status_explanation: The DP grievance has been resolved.
RESOLVED.recommended_action: Verify demat account holdings and download an updated statement.
suggested_documents: Resolution letter from DP (may be useful for your personal records)
RESOLVED.escalation_path: None required unless resolution is not honored
RESOLVED.guidance_notes: Retain resolution records alongside your financial account records.

FURTHER_ACTION.status_explanation: The DP complaint is ready for official escalation to CDSL/NSDL, SEBI SCORES 2.0, or SMART ODR.
FURTHER_ACTION.recommended_action: File escalation on SEBI SCORES 2.0 or SMART ODR citing your DP complaint ticket and attaching the acknowledgement.
suggested_documents: DP acknowledgement receipt (may be useful for your grievance record)
Demat statement reflecting disputed debit/credit (may be useful for your grievance record)
Copy of original complaint (may be useful for your grievance record)
DP response if received (may be useful for your grievance record)
Escalation filing receipt from SCORES / SMART ODR once submitted
FURTHER_ACTION.conditions: Response overdue under demo configuration or response rejected by investor.
FURTHER_ACTION.guidance_notes: Investors can escalate against DPs through the depository grievance portal or SEBI SCORES 2.0.
FURTHER_ACTION.disclaimer: Official regulatory process information. Any simulated time windows are demo configurations for testing.

response_window_exceeded.title: DP Response Window Exceeded Notice
response_window_exceeded.explanation: FlowGuard detected that the recorded elapsed time exceeds the configured window (e.g. 30-day demo configuration) with no DP response recorded.
response_window_exceeded.recommended_step: You may prepare to escalate to CDSL/NSDL or SEBI SCORES 2.0 using your DP ticket reference.

potential_delay.title: DP Potential Delay Notice
potential_delay.explanation: No status update has been recorded from the Depository Participant within expected benchmark time.
potential_delay.recommended_step: Follow up with the DP Grievance Cell referencing your ticket number.

awaiting_response.title: Awaiting DP Response
awaiting_response.explanation: Complaint is within normal processing window with the Depository Participant.
awaiting_response.recommended_step: FlowGuard is tracking this stage. No immediate action required.
